verdict.rationale: Gmail's own features touch two parts of this story. A community report confirms in-email RSVP widgets on invitations, which covers responding to invites. Gemini can propose meeting times from your Google Calendar availability, which reads calendar data inside Gmail. There is no evidence of viewing the calendar itself or creating events from Gmail, and Workspace add-ons are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented in-client calendar view, documented event creation from Gmail, first-party docs for invite RSVP.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: One user finds Gmail's added widgets, such as RSVP on invitations and itineraries on flight booking emails, pretty useful.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
